definitions.explanation: A target for shooting or attack, or figuratively, the object of criticism, blame, or attention.

examples.japanese: {標的|ひょうてき}に{命中|めいちゅう}した。
いじめの{標的|ひょうてき}にされた。
examples.english: I was made a target of bullying.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{批判|ひはん}の{標的|ひょうてき}になりやすいタイプだ。
examples.english: He is the type who easily becomes a target of criticism.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {標的|ひょうてき}になる: to become a target
- {標的|ひょうてき}にする: to target, to make a target of
- {批判|ひはん}の{標的|ひょうてき}: target of criticism
- {攻撃|こうげき}の{標的|ひょうてき}: target of attack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {的|まと}: target (more colloquial; also used in archery/darts)
- {目標|もくひょう}: goal, objective (positive connotation; something to aim for)
- {対象|たいしょう}: object, subject (neutral; used for surveys, research, policies)
